Most checkpoints were marked 'is_testable: false' because the image is a macro shot of food, not an architectural scene. This is accurate; you cannot test for windows or facades in a close-up. However, the Router was slightly lenient on 'Breads pastries and cakes visible in display.' While a pastry is present, it is NOT 'in display' (i.e., in a case/window). It is on a wrapper. I will mark this as Missing/Incorrect context in the final scoring.
artifact_review: The Router identified text gibberish (severity 3.5) and texture anomalies (severity 1.5). The 'fine_grained_classifier' failed to identify the object as 'bakery' (ranking it 3rd behind 'potpie' and 'honeycomb'), which reinforces the alignment failure. The 'perceptual_quality_auditor' found slight compression but missed the structural/textural 'waxiness' noted by the Router. I agree with the Router's higher severity assessment for texture.
